create_PriorityInterpreterPoolExecutor: create a PriorityInterpreterPoolExecutor with max_workers to prioritize downstream pipeline stages over upstream ones
get_executor_from_pool: call get_executor on a PriorityInterpreterPoolExecutor to create a per-stage executor with auto-assigned priority
submit_with_priority: submit a callable to the executor using _submit_with_priority with a priority tuple for ordering
shutdown_executor_with_cancel: shutdown the PriorityInterpreterPoolExecutor with cancel_futures to cancel pending work items in the queue
pickle_executor_for_subprocess: pickle a PriorityInterpreterPoolExecutor and restore it via __setstate__ for use with run_pipeline_in_subprocess
